name: Readymix Construction Machinery Ltd
about: Incorporated in 2012, Readymix Construction Machinery Limited is a multidisciplinary manufacturer and supplier in the construction equipment sector.[1]
keyPoints:
Business Profile[1]
Readymix Construction Machinery Limited is an engineering-led company specializing in the design, development, fabrication, and installation of plant & machinery for cement, concrete, crushing, construction, and building materials industries.

pros: Company has a good return on equity (ROE) track record: 3 Years ROE 34.5%
cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Company has high debtors of 242 days.
Working capital days have increased from 112 days to 218 days
